rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted. Owners must give tenants written notice of the Ordinance and their rights at the start of a lease or with any rent increase notice.
rules.key_value: lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period; no increase if CPI is negative
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property and mobile home spaces in Santa Ana, except buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990. Owners may petition the City Manager for relief from the cap to obtain a fair and reasonable return.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days, an owner may not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice, and must first give notice of the violation with time to fix it. For no-fault terminations the owner must provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: 3 months of relocation assistance or waiver of rent for the final 3 months (no-fault)
rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies in Santa Ana after 30 days, except housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
